newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical buys Progressive Angioplasty.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical buys Progressive Angioplasty.

text.p: United States Surgical Corp said Tuesday it had acquired an exclusive option to purchase all of the outstanding shares of Progressive Angioplasty Systems.

Under the option agreement, Surgical said it will purchase 12-1/2 percent of Progressive for $15 million. It will have a six-month evaluation period in which to exercise its right to acquire the balance of the company, it said.

The purchase price, if exercised, will be $75 million, with a potential additional $75 million payable depending on whether or not certain milestones and sales objectives are met, it added. Progressive develops and markets interventional cardiology products like coronary angioplasty catheters and coronary stents. United States Surgical Corp is a diversified surgical products company.
